step1_analysis.description: A 4-phase current-mode logic (CML) clock buffer with a shared tail current and source follower outputs. It buffers 25% duty cycle clock pulses to drive the data switches in a one-stage 4:1 multiplexer, sharing a single tail current to save power since only one pulse is active at a time.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current: Id = 0.5 * 270uA/V^2 * (5u/1u) * (1.0V - 0.42V)^2 = 227uA. Source followers (with 1k pull-downs added in TB): 4 * 1.2V / 1k = 4.8mA. Total current ~ 5mA. Power = 5mA * 1.8V = 9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 70mW for the entire MUX. This sub-block consumes a fraction of that. The added testbench resistors dominate the power.

v_swing.description: Transient voltage swing at the output

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing at N0 = I_tail * R_load = 227uA * 1k = 227mV. Source follower gain ~ 0.8, so output swing at P1 is ~180mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load resistors added in the testbench. 1k ohm gives ~180mV swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Node capacitance ~ 50fF (due to L=0.5u). R = 1k. Tau = 50ps. BW = 1 / (2*pi*50ps) = 3.18 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The L=0.5u in the netlist limits the bandwidth compared to the 0.13um process used in the paper.

t_delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output

sky130_expected.reasoning: RC time constant of the internal nodes.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, AC bandwidth, transient voltage swing, and delay of the 4-channel CML buffer. Missing load and pull-down resistors are added to make the circuit functional.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for 4-channel CML buffer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM8 VDD N4 P3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM3 N4 P3_BAR N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N0 P1_BAR N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM7 VDD N3 P4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM4 N3 P4_BAR N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM10 VDD N0 P1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM6 N11 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM2 N2 P2_BAR N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 N1 BIAS N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM9 VDD N2 P2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 1.0

* Missing load resistors for CML
R1 VDD N0 1k
R2 VDD N2 1k
R3 VDD N4 1k
R4 VDD N3 1k

* Missing pull-down resistors for source followers
RP1 P1 0 1k
RP2 P2 0 1k
RP3 P3 0 1k
RP4 P4 0 1k

* Inputs (25% duty cycle pulses)
VP1 P1_BAR 0 DC 1.5 AC 1 PULSE(1.2 1.8 0 5p 5p 23.3p 133.3p)
VP2 P2_BAR 0 DC 1.2 PULSE(1.2 1.8 33.3p 5p 5p 23.3p 133.3p)
VP3 P3_BAR 0 DC 1.2 PULSE(1.2 1.8 66.6p 5p 5p 23.3p 133.3p)
VP4 P4_BAR 0 DC 1.2 PULSE(1.2 1.8 100p 5p 5p 23.3p 133.3p)

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 10 100M 100G
let gain_db = vdb(P1)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=100M
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

tran 1p 400p
meas tran v_max max v(P1)
meas tran v_min min v(P1)
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

let v20 = v_min + 0.2 * v_swing
let v80 = v_min + 0.8 * v_swing
meas tran t_rise trig v(P1) val=v20 rise=1 targ v(P1) val=v80 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(P1) val=v80 fall=1 targ v(P1) val=v20 fall=1

meas tran t_delay trig v(P1_BAR) val=1.5 rise=1 targ v(P1) val=(v_min+v_max)/2 fall=1

quit
.endc
